IGUI_NE_Report_Title: Top Secret: NOX:EVOLVED Report & Specimen Transfer Plan
IGUI_NE_Report_Intro: According to my military contact, the final airstrike is about 50 days away. The virus has begun to 'evolve' rapidly, exceeding initial predictions. The dead are transforming, and the environment itself is being consumed by the infection. I wanted to get you to the airport and save you, but... I'm surrounded here. I kept you in stasis for five years to let you adapt, not as an experiment, but because I believed you could survive this hell. Forgive me.
IGUI_NE_Report_Mission: I can't move anymore. Head to the terminal in the deepest part of the military research facility. Your 'mutation' might stabilize below the critical threshold, and there might be a code to stop the airstrike. I stole four access keys from the military and hid them in my underground bases in each location.
IGUI_NE_Report_Note: ※ The military's cleanup crew (SWAT) has been deployed. They won't leave any witnesses. Be careful.
IGUI_NE_GOAL: Military Research Facility B17 Command Room (MAP: 5573, 12432, -17)
